hinotify-0.4.2.osx: Linux-only API: the pinned Cabal description identifies the Linux kernel inotify interface; System/INotify.hsc requires sys/inotify.h. Tested in the Linux matrix cell.

pthread-0.2.1.osx: Pinned source System/Posix/Thread.hsc uses #type pthread_t, requiring an arithmetic pthread_t. Darwin defines a pointer pthread_t and upstream's native template cannot compile it. This package/ABI combination is inapplicable, not a candidate success; tested on Linux's integer pthread_t.
